Content Delivery Platform fully functional prototype

risks.title: Consortium complexity
risks.mitigation: Use structured governance and strong project management.

risks.title: Partner delivery delays
risks.mitigation: Reallocate work and analyse capacity constraints.

risks.title: Partner conflicts
risks.mitigation: Use governance and consortium agreement procedures to resolve conflicts.

risks.title: Key partner withdrawal
risks.mitigation: Seek a transparent replacement where needed.

risks.title: Other partner withdrawal
risks.mitigation: Redistribute or replace the affected contribution.

risks.title: Output quality shortfall
risks.mitigation: Use quality procedures, peer review and early testing.

risks.title: Insufficient open-call interest
risks.mitigation: Advertise broadly and simplify online applications.

risks.title: Complex shared open-call budget
risks.mitigation: Set out management terms in the consortium agreement.

risks.title: Programme does not meet user needs
risks.mitigation: Co-design and validate activities with local stakeholders.

risks.title: Platform or network features miss deployment needs
risks.mitigation: Ground requirements in existing research and prototypes.
